newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GD Express sees moves ex-Netherlands to UK.
newsitem.headline: GD Express sees moves ex-Netherlands to UK.

text.p: GD Express Worldwide, the express mail joint venture, is to move a small number of corporate departments from the Netherlands to the U.K., the company said in a statement.

The company, which trades as TNT Express Worldwide and which has its headquarters in Amsterdam, will relocate a number of departments to offices in Windsor to make maximum use of its property assets ,it added.
GD Express spokeswoman, Elena Elorriaga, said she could not specify which departments will move or when.
She told Reuters in a telephone interview that she could not release information which has not yet been provide to TNT staff, some of whom would be affected by the plan.
More details would be available when the company has further clarified which departments are to move.
GD Express is jointly owned by TNT Ltd of Australia and GD Net BV, a partnership of the postal dministrations of the Netherlands and Sweden.
Earlier today in London, GD Express also announced that its XP Express Parcel System subsidiary would be absorbed by another subsidiary -- TNT Express Worldwide -- with immediate effect.
A spokeswoman said this was a formal recognition of what already existed in practice. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
